thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: KV cache + continuous-batching regression detected on inference-prod (us-west-2). Spike in KV memory and backpressure causing 95th latency to jump and request throttles. Affected models: llama-13b-mqa, mistral-7b-gqa, qwen-14b-mqa.

sara: acked. paging now. i'm oncall til 04:00 UTC. assigning triage -> matt + linh. tagging cs for customer impact. @anna @sam please standby. :phone:

matt: seeing sustained KV cache miss amplification. wavefront shows contbatch queue length skyrocketing and GPU utilization flattening (workers stuck). error-rates up ~3x. probable continuous-batching interaction with MQA parallel paths.

linh: i can take a look at batch config and evictions. quick mitigation idea: temporarily disable continuous batching on the three model routes and reduce max_batch_tokens. low-risk hotpatch first.

jose: agreed. also prepare model fallback routes to smaller quantized variants (llama-13b -> llama-7b-q8) in case latency persists. we should avoid customer-visible 5xxs.

sam: logging customer impact: Support queue shows 4 notices from two enterprise customers reporting timeouts ~ 10m. i'll draft an update once we have confirmed mitigation.

matt: running quick check: current contbatch config snapshot:
```
route: /v1/llama-13b-mqa
continuous_batching: enabled
max_batch_tokens: 4096
batch_timeout_ms: 15
kv_cache_mode: persistent
kv_eviction_policy: lru_shards
```
Observed: contbatch queue backlog rising to 1200 requests, avg service_time per token increased 2.8x.

linh: applying hotfix to disable continuous batching on affected routes. will also lower max_batch_tokens to 2048 and batch_timeout_ms to 5. patch command:
```bash
# feature-flag flip via control plane API
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" \
  -d '{"route":"/v1/llama-13b-mqa","continuous_batching":false,"max_batch_tokens":2048,"batch_timeout_ms":5}' \
  https://controlplane.internal.api/v1/routes/patch
```
kubectl patch configmap batch-config -n inference --type merge -p '{"data":{"llama-13b-mqa":"continuous_batching=false\nmax_batch_tokens=2048\nbatch_timeout_ms=5"}}'
```

deploy-bot: Rolling update started for route /v1/llama-13b-mqa (canary -> 2 pods).

matt: after toggle: queue depth dropped ~70% in 90s, 95th latency down from 1.8s -> 520ms for llama route, GPU idle returned to normal. KV write amplification still slightly elevated but stabilizing.

jose: pushed fallback routing for mistral and qwen to smaller quantized variants as pre-caution. route config snippet:
```
if latency > 900ms for 30s -> route to mistral-7b-q8
```

anna: CS note: drafting customer message. high-level: intermittent timeouts 20:40-21:05 UTC affecting embeddings/generation on specific model variants; mitigation in progress; engineering will follow up. will link incident ticket.

sam: support update queued. no immediate upgrades to contracts required, customers flagged for postmortem.

linh: additional durable fix items: investigate contbatch algorithm edge-case where KV eviction and batch coalescing race for high-cardinality prefixes (seen with MQA). suspect the prefetch heuristics cause cache blowups under bursty prefix distributions.

matt: opened ticket INF-4321 and added dump of KV shard metrics + contbatch traces. owners: eng-runtime (matt), infra (linh).

incident-bot: Incident created: https://playbook.internal/incidents/INF-4321 (severity: P2 -> monitoring, customer-impact acknowledged).

sara: handing off to night oncall @linh at 03:55 UTC. summary for handoff: hotpatch applied (continuous batching disabled on affected routes), reduced max_batch_tokens, fallback routes enabled, KV eviction stabilized but needs deeper postmortem. watch: kv_eviction_count, contbatch_queue_depth, p95 latency per-route.

linh: ack. i'll keep the mitigation in place and run controlled experiments in staging overnight to reproduce cache-amplification with synthetic high-cardinality prefixes. will post findings in incident thread.

matt: followups: 1) revert only after staged test confirms no regression 2) add metric alert for contbatch queue > 300 for > 2m 3) evaluate prefetch heuristic clamp for MQA models 4) customer-facing RCA draft.

anna: thanks everyone — CS will hold off customer-wide comms until we have a clearer RCA. will send an interim note in 60m. :email:

sam: closing immediate support queue items as affected customers acknowledged interim mitigation.

incident-bot: Reminder: create postmortem doc in 24h and link to INF-4321.

sara: closing pager for me, handing completely to @linh. good job team. :thumbsup:

linh: night oncall here — will report any anomalies to this thread. starting deeper trace capture now:
```bash
kubectl exec -n inference -c probe deploy/contbatch-tracer -- /bin/sh -c 'curl http://localhost:9090/debug/trace > /tmp/contbatch-trace-3712345678.log'
```

matt: leaving a checklist in the ticket for next morning: metric dashboards to add, perf regression gating for next rollout, and a proposed change to KV shard eviction thresholds.

anna: saving draft of customer note to INF-4321 > communications > drafts.

linh: updating incident status to monitoring. will escalate if queues spike again. :eyes:

end.
